name: Structure, Transport, and Reactions in Bio-Nano Systems
description: Intra- and extra-cellular components, structure, and transport; governing equations applied to biological systems: conservation laws, flux equations, mathematical functions and solutions, scaling and order, laminar flow. Electromechanical transport: biomolecular migration through blood capillaries, Poisson-Boltzmann equation in heterogeneous media, electrical-shear stress balance in electrical double layers. Transport across membranes: structure and self-assembly of lipid bilayers, membrane permeability, Nernst potential, adsorption isotherms and transport across membrane. Research-specific case studies on the solution of coupled migration phenomena involving reactive, electrical, and heterogeneity considerations.
